heading: G6_Area And Perimeter Real Life Word Problems

topics.heading: Area And Perimeter Real Life Word Problems

question:
A bedroom wall is 9 m long and 4 m high. One litre of paint can cover 6 m².

How many litres of paint should be bought to give the wall one coat?
Answer: ______ litres

A farmer has a rectangular horse paddock that is 22 m long and 16 m wide.

How many metres of fencing are needed to completely enclose the paddock?
Answer: ______ m

A triangular garden has a base of 18 m and a perpendicular height of 10 m . Fertiliser costs $5 per square metre.

How much will it cost to cover the garden with fertiliser?
Answer: $______

A square picnic blanket has sides measuring 3.5 m . Decorative lace is sewn all the way around the edge.

How much lace is needed?
Answer: ______ m

A wooden fence is to be built around the outside of the given parallelogram-shaped garden. The garden has side lengths of 18 m and 9 m.

How many metres of fencing are required?
Answer: ______ m

A rectangular living room floor measures 9 m by 6 m . Wooden flooring costs $25 per square metre.
Mr Wilson has a budget of $1,300 to buy the flooring.
Will his budget be enough?

A rectangular whiteboard measures 3.2 m by 1.5 m . Decorative ribbon will be placed around the edge
Noah says that 9.4 m of ribbon is needed.
Emma says that 8.8 m of ribbon is needed.
Who is correct?

A square courtyard has sides measuring 15 m . Jack has 58 m of fencing to place around the courtyard.
Does Jack have enough fencing?

A rectangular warehouse roof measures 15 m by 10 m . Solar panels cost $180 per square metre.
Sophia says it will cost $27,000 to cover the roof with solar panels.
Oliver says it will cost $25,200 to cover the roof with solar panels.
Who is correct?

A triangular shade sail has a base of 14 m and a perpendicular height of 8 m . Waterproof fabric costs $20 per square metre.
The event organiser has $1,000 to buy the fabric.
Is this enough money?

A rectangular school library measures 24 m long and 18 m wide. Decorative lights are hung all around the walls.
The school bought 90 m of lights.
Will all of the lights be used? If not, how many metres will be left over?

options.text: No, 2 m will be left over.
No, 6 m will be left over.
No, 10 m will be left over.
